🌟 VidBee | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To download, organize, transcribe, and analyze video and audio content from various online sources and local files using AI.
✨ Key Features: • Download video and audio from 1000+ sites • Import local media • Create searchable transcripts locally • Speaker detection and labeling • Timestamped playback
📖 Summary: VidBee is a desktop application for downloading and organizing video and audio from over 1000 websites. It allows users to create searchable transcripts locally, summarize, translate, and query media using AI, while also supporting local media import and flexible export options.
